proxies.sub: Global proxy list; plugins pick one from a dropdown, default is direct
proxies.loadFailed: Could not load the proxy list

list.title: Proxies
list.emptyHint: A plugin whose proxy field is empty connects directly; once you add a proxy you can pick it from the dropdown in plugin settings.

proxies.note: "Direct" is not a proxy entry: leave a plugin's proxy field empty to connect directly. Deleting a proxy that is in use pauses the instances using it and clears their proxy setting; choose a new proxy before resuming them.

legend.title: Available on
legend.meta: Decides which run locations can pick it
legend.hub: Only plugins running on the Raspberry Pi, e.g. a proxy that listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
legend.lan: The hub and agents on the LAN; agents on a public VPS cannot pick it.
legend.any: Every run location, including a VPS the hub dials out to.

drawer.name: Name
drawer.passwordHelp: Stored encrypted, never shown again. When changing the password, re-enter the username too.
drawer.remoteDnsLabel: Resolve domain names on the proxy server
drawer.remoteDnsHelp: socks5h always resolves remotely; socks5 is optional; http and https proxies resolve on the proxy side, nothing to set.
drawer.testHelp: Defaults to the Google 204 address and can be changed; the test uses the saved settings, not unsaved edits.

deleteDialog.title: Delete proxy "{{name}}"?
deleteDialog.bodyRefs: {{count}} instance(s) use it. These instances will be paused and their proxy setting cleared; choose a new proxy for them before resuming:
deleteDialog.bodyNone: No instance uses it, so it can be deleted right away.
deleteDialog.ack: I understand these instances will be paused
deleteDialog.inUse: An instance just started using this proxy; please review the affected instances.

settings.sub: Global hub settings; changes take effect after saving

general.title: General
general.languageHelp: Global language for plugin text and notifications; use the 中/EN switch in the sidebar for this browser's UI language.
general.timezoneHelp: Schedules, logs and backup times all follow this time zone.
general.accessUrlHelp: Used for links in push messages; leave empty to omit links.

net.title: Network & security
net.httpsNow: This page is served over {{scheme}} · port {{port}}
net.httpsHelp: Direct HTTPS uses a self-signed certificate, so browsers will warn; an nginx reverse proxy is recommended for HTTPS. The hub must restart for a change to apply.
net.trustedHelp: Empty by default. X-Forwarded-* is only honored from these sources; the same headers from anywhere else are ignored.

display.title: Display
display.reduceHelp: Turns off glow and motion; suits always-on screens or weak hardware. Same switch as on the Schedule page.
display.themeHelp: Light by default; affects the admin UI only, applies immediately and is remembered in this browser, no need to save. The screen theme is set under Schedule & themes.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.label: History
retention.help: Three downsampling tiers; data past its limit is purged by the hub periodically.

backup.title: Backups
backup.dailyHelp: Backup files are written to the backups directory inside the hub data directory.
backup.nasHelp: Encrypted sync to a NAS, coming in phase 2.

downloadWarn.title: Download backup
downloadWarn.body: The archive contains key files (encryption key, agent credentials, notification tokens). Keep it safe and never upload it anywhere public.

bar.hint: Applies on save; the HTTPS switch needs a hub restart
